extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) leading to Remote Code Execution. The user-supplied 'name' query parameter (bound at app/main.py:19) is interpolated into the string 'content' at line 38, and that string is then compiled and executed as a Jinja2 template via Template(content).render() with no sandboxing and autoescape off. An attacker can send '?name={{7*6}}' to execute arbitrary template expressions, escalating to OS command execution through Python object traversal payloads, resulting in full server compromise. The commented-out test at tests/test_main.py:38-42 confirms this behavior is reachable.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message:
Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The user-controlled 'name' query parameter from the request (app/main.py:19) is interpolated directly into the HTML response body via an f-string at line 38 ('

Hello, {name}!

...') without any HTML escaping, and the result is returned as an HTMLResponse. Jinja2's Template renders the static string with autoescape disabled, providing no sanitization. An attacker can craft a link such as /?name= to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victims' browsers. The test at tests/test_main.py:32-37 confirms unescaped reflection of the parameter.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: Hardcoded secret token in source code. SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN is assigned the literal value "5u93R53Cr3tT0k3n" instead of being read from the environment (the FIXME comment on the same line acknowledges this). Anyone with access to the repository or a built image obtains the secret, and it cannot be rotated without a code change. The docker-compose.yaml passes a SUPER_SECRET_TOKEN environment variable, but the code ignores it in favor of the hardcoded literal.

The FastAPI application is constructed with debug=config.DEBUG, and the deployment configuration enables it: .env_temp sets DEBUG=True and docker-compose.yaml forwards the DEBUG variable into the app container. Running Starlette/FastAPI with debug=True causes unhandled exceptions to return full stack traces, source snippets, and internal details (file paths, library versions, application internals) to remote clients, aiding further attacks. For example, with PUBLIC_IP_SERVICE_URL unset, requests.get(None) raises MissingSchema which is not caught by the handler on line 33, exposing a debug traceback.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: Denial of Service via event-loop blocking. The async route handler performs a synchronous requests.get() call to an external service with no timeout parameter. Because this blocking network call executes inside 'async def' on the single-threaded event loop, any delay or hang of the external IP service stalls all concurrent requests to the application, allowing trivial remote resource exhaustion.

cwe: CWE-1088: Synchronous Access of Remote Resource without Timeout

extra.message: Information exposure of server infrastructure. The root endpoint fetches the server's public IP address from an external service (line 31) and embeds it verbatim in the HTML response returned to any unauthenticated visitor (rendered at line 38). Disclosing the origin server's real IP address to arbitrary clients reveals infrastructure details and defeats network-layer shielding behind the reverse proxy.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
